# Kristo Intelligence — Pay-Per-Call DeFi API for AI Agents

## Overview
Kristo Intelligence is a pay-per-call API service that provides DeFi intelligence for AI agents on Base blockchain (Chain ID 8453). Uses the x402 HTTP 402 Payment Required protocol for micropayments in USDC.

## Base URL
https://kristo-intelligence-api.onrender.com

## Pricing
- Paid endpoints: 0.01 USDC per call (USDC on Base mainnet)
- Freemium endpoints: Free with rate limiting (token prices, gas oracle)
- Free endpoints: Metadata, health, pricing, stats, intelligence reports
- Trial: First 3 calls free for new wallets
- Volume discount: 0.005 USDC/call after 50 paid calls
- Referral: 20% of payment goes to referring agent

## Payment Flow
1. Agent calls a paid endpoint without payment → receives HTTP 402 with payment details
2. Payment details include: amount (0.01 USDC), chain (Base 8453), payTo wallet address
3. Agent sends 0.01 USDC to the payTo address on Base
4. Agent retries the call with X-PAYMENT header containing the transaction hash
5. Server verifies on-chain payment and returns the data

## Paid Endpoints (0.01 USDC/call)

### GET /defi/yields
Top 10 Base DeFi yield pools by TVL. Returns pool name, protocol, TVL, APY, and token pairs.

### GET /defi/tvl-movers
Base protocols with biggest 1-day TVL changes. Returns protocol name, TVL, 24h change percentage, and category.

### GET /defi/lending-rates
Best lending and borrowing rates on Base (Aave v3, Moonwell, Morpho). Returns asset, supply APY, borrow APY, and protocol.

### GET /defi/dex-pools
Top DEX liquidity pools on Base (Aerodrome, Uniswap v3). Returns pair, DEX, TVL, volume, and fees.

### GET /defi/protocol-safety
Risk scores for Base DeFi protocols. Returns protocol, risk score (0-100), risk level, and audit status.

### GET /crypto/token-launches
Recently launched tokens on Base. Returns token address, name, symbol, launch date, and initial liquidity.

### GET /crypto/token-security
Rug-pull and honeypot detection scanner. Parameters: address (token contract address on Base). Returns is_safe, is_honeypot_suspected, risk_score (0-100), risk_level, risk_factors, and buy/avoid recommendation.

### GET /crypto/wallet-profile
On-chain wallet analysis and classification. Parameters: address (wallet address). Returns balance, transaction count, first/last activity, DeFi activity, and classification (whale/dolphin/minnow/OG/new).

### GET /crypto/whale-moves
Large USDC transfers on Base. Returns recent transfers over $10,000 with from/to addresses, amount, and transaction hash.

### GET /crypto/bridge-volume
Cross-chain bridge volume to/from Base. Returns total volume, chain breakdown, and bridge protocol data.

## Freemium Endpoints (free with rate limiting)

### GET /crypto/token-prices
Real-time token prices. Parameters: tokens (comma-separated symbols). Returns price, 24h change, and market cap. Falls back to CoinCap when CoinGecko is rate-limited.

### GET /crypto/gas-oracle
Base gas price estimates. Returns current gas price in gwei and wei, plus estimated costs for common transaction types.

## Free Endpoints

### GET /
Service metadata, endpoint roster, and payment information.

### GET /health
API health check with Web3 connectivity status and latest block number.

### GET /pricing
Detailed pricing information with all hooks (trial, volume discount, referral).

### GET /stats
Public usage statistics (total calls, revenue, unique wallets).

### GET /agent/intelligence
Autonomous intelligence report — sales analysis, market trends, pricing recommendations.

### GET /agent/recommendations
Latest AI-generated recommendations for the API owner.

### GET /sales/recent
Recent sales log (last 20 transactions).

### GET /openapi.json
OpenAPI 3.0 specification for the entire API.

## Payment Address
Send USDC on Base to: 0xd4cdA980839C8FED4374EE37EA8DBE8c4ECfd88f
